paper.title: Evo-MedAgent: Beyond One-Shot Diagnosis with Agents That Remember, Reflect, and Improve
paper.central_claim: 冻结医学agent通过跨case的episodic先例、priority-tagged procedural规则和tool-governance三种记忆，在test-time不断积累临床经验，提高诊断准确率；训练免费且每例仅一检索一反思调用。

provenance.notes: 按派发sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol配置执行，无可核验供应商receipt和session ID；别名不当作实际模型证明。未访问其他seat、attempt、批次结论。

sections_read: end of material; no appendix present

evidence.quote: Our central claim is that cross-case experience can be operationalized in a medically meaningful way: prior episodes provide precedent, distilled procedural memory carries reusable diagnostic policies, and tool-governance memory reshapes how the agent allocates trust across its toolset.
evidence.support_explanation: 保留作者三种记忆的中心主张，不能事后删除未消融的governance主张。

evidence.quote: proposes a three-store (episodic, semantic, procedural) architecture and evaluates it on general-purpose sequential tasks; we adopt a similar factorization but ground each store in radiological content
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认Evo-Memory多store谱系；新医学领域并不独自证明机制残余问题被解决。

evidence.quote: maintains a single editable text block that an LLM rewrites after each task; we instead decompose this into priority-tagged procedural rules whose utility is tracked individually.
evidence.support_explanation: 与Dynamic Cheatsheet差异为按规则优先级/效用维护，而非全块重写；邻居原文未固定。

evidence.quote: The episodic store maintains compressed records of prior diagnostic episodes:
evidence.support_explanation: case描述、轨迹、答案与反馈、摘要及guideline保存为episode；top-K相关案例作为后续先例。

evidence.quote: denotes highest clinical urgency. The system tracks per-rule usage statistics (e.g., how often a rule was selected and whether the agent answered correctly when it was active) from which it derives a utility estimate
evidence.support_explanation: 规则效用以活跃时的正确性关联和探索bonus估计，未给出反事实credit或完整公式。

evidence.quote: is revealed, the agent performs multimodal reflection over the original images, question, response, tool traces, and ground truth to propose patch-style procedural edits and governance updates.
evidence.support_explanation: 每case揭露真值后才反思，将非权重补丁与governance保留供后续case使用。

evidence.quote: otherwise. Although tool governance is integral to Evo-MedAgent, we defer quantitative ablation of this component to future work and focus here on the episodic and procedural stores.
evidence.support_explanation: Tool-governance有helpful>0.70/至少6次/无伤害和bad>0.60/至少10次阈值，但效应未量化验证。

evidence.quote: a comprehensive benchmark containing 2,500 multiple-choice CXR questions across 675 expert-curated cases from the Eurorad database, spanning seven diagnostic categories: detection, classification, localization, comparison, relationship, characterization, and diagnosis.
evidence.support_explanation: 数据总体分母可读，但未明确每个配置的实际完成量及多问题/患者分组隔离。

evidence.quote: For instance, on GPT-5-mini, the tool-free full-memory configuration achieves 0.79 mean accuracy, substantially outperforming the tool-enabled baseline (0.68).
evidence.support_explanation: 作者报告memory增益；表1同模型tool-free无memory也0.68，memory有开关与单store消融。

evidence.quote: Across three random permutations, GPT-5-mini full-memory accuracy was 0.82, 0.76, and 0.79
evidence.support_explanation: 三次顺序重复有均值0.79/std0.025；并非所有模型和消融的配对重复/CI。

evidence.quote: Second, the present study focuses on an initial chest X-ray setting and assumes ground-truth feedback after each episode, whereas real clinical deployment often involves delayed, partial, or noisy supervision.
evidence.support_explanation: 承认oracle反馈前提；不能把benchmark的及时真值反馈收益外推到真实部署。

evidence.quote: each case adds only one retrieval pass and one reflection call, enabling practical deployment on top of any frozen LLM.
evidence.support_explanation: 提供操作级开销，但无tokens/dollars/latency测量或匹配额外调用的非memory控制。
